name: @retorika/publisher
description: Packages the site: HTML, CSS, images, sitemap, ZIP
comment: No third-party runtime dependency beyond the two font packages, whose bytes are the deliverable: the woff2 files travel into the client's ZIP exactly as @fontsource ships them, which is what the OFL's Reserved Font Name on Playfair Display requires. The ZIP itself is written by hand against node:zlib rather than pulled from a supply chain.
